svg.aria-label: Benchmark results with Jev routing on and off
svg.text: Same task, same model: Jev routing on vs. off
Bars are medians, dots are the individual runs (4 to 5 per mode), drawn relative to each pair's baseline median.
Lower is better, except for checks passed. GPT models ran in Codex, Claude models in Claude Code, both without MCP servers or plugins.
Solved runs and what Jev itself cost
Solved 5/5 with routing, 5/5 without. Jev steered 24 of 24 requests for $0.005.
